description:
Drop the 'methods take &str/&[&str]' pattern and adopt typed jmap_types::Id (and jmap_types::State for state fields) across the entire *-client crate family. Public-API breaking change \u2014 scheduled for the 0.2.0 major.

## Why this exists

JMAP-231o.6 settled on Option A (full internal validation via Id::new_validated, keep &str API) for the 0.1.x publish. Option A code is throwaway scaffolding that becomes dead at the 0.2.0 break. Option C (typed &[Id] API) was the better engineering choice but requires coordinated public-API changes across all *-client crates plus per-change approval on the locked one.

This epic schedules Option C for 0.2.0 with each *-client crate as a child bead so the work parallelises cleanly.

## Why typed Id is the right shape

1. **Make invalid states unrepresentable.** With &[&str] every method must remember to call validate_ids_field; forget once \u2192 silent regression. With &[Id] the type system enforces validation at the Id construction boundary; impossible to forget.

2. **Eliminate redundant work.** &[&str] revalidates on every call. &[Id] validates once at construction; the rest of the program trusts the type.

3. **Workspace consistency.** jmap-types ships Id / State / UTCDate newtypes specifically so callers can use them. The locked server crates take &Id. The *-client crates are the only place that punts on this and accepts raw &str.

4. **Vacuous tests evaporate.** The 'calendar_get_empty_id_returns_invalid_argument' family of smoke tests can't be written under typed-Id because Id::new_validated('') returns Err \u2014 the test would fail at constructing the invalid input. The bug becomes impossible to express, so the test is unnecessary.

## Scope

In scope:
- Convert &str / &[&str] / &Vec<String> 'this is an Id' parameters to &Id / &[Id] / &Vec<Id> in every *-client method signature.
- Convert &str / String 'this is a State' parameters to &State / State (subsumes JMAP-231o.3).
- Remove the validate_id_field / validate_ids_field helpers added by JMAP-231o.6 (Option A scaffolding).
- Delete the smoke tests that asserted on 'empty id' / 'empty state' guards \u2014 they become impossible-to-express under typed parameters.
- Update README + PLAN.md drift sections in each crate.

Out of scope:
- jmap-base-client signatures \u2014 LOCKED; minimal surface (api_url is a free-form URL not an Id; Session is a typed struct already). Verify zero changes needed; if changes are needed, separate per-change approval gate.
- Server crates \u2014 already take &Id, this is purely a client-side fix.
- jmap-types itself \u2014 the typed Id newtype already exists; nothing to change.

## Decomposition

One child per *-client crate; the work parallelises after the calendars-client child lands the pattern (which will define the conventions for the others to follow):

  .1 jmap-calendars-client \u2014 the reference impl; defines the conventions
  .2 jmap-mail-client      \u2014 sister crate; same pattern; PER-CHANGE APPROVAL needed if locked
  .3 jmap-chat-client      \u2014 same pattern
  .4 jmap-contacts-client  \u2014 same pattern
  .5 jmap-tasks-client     \u2014 same pattern
  .6 jmap-filenode-client  \u2014 same pattern
  .7 jmap-sharing-client   \u2014 same pattern

## Coordination

This is a 0.2.0 break. Coordinate the version bump across all 7 *-client crates simultaneously with a single PR (or a stack of PRs landing together). Update top-level README to call out the API change.

## Subsumes

- bd:JMAP-231o.3 (state fields are String, jmap-types provides State newtype) \u2014 the state-field migration is part of this epic.
- bd:JMAP-231o.6 \u2014 the Option A scaffolding from this bead becomes dead code under this epic and should be deleted as part of .1 (calendars-client).

## Pre-publish reminder

Before publishing 0.1.x, add a 'API stability' note to the top-level README explaining that 0.1.x is a preview release, the *-client APIs will change in 0.2.0 (typed Id parameters), and consumers should pin to '0.1' if they want stability or to '0.2' once it ships if they want the cleaner API.
notes: Filed 2026-05-09 after Mark's choice on JMAP-231o.6 to defer Option C to 0.2.0. The Option A scaffolding (validate_id_field / validate_ids_field helpers + 11 call sites in calendars-client) is throwaway code that will be deleted by .1 of this epic. The smoke tests asserting on empty-id behaviour will also be deleted because typed-Id makes the bug impossible to express.
title: EPIC: adopt typed Id parameters across *-client crates (0.2.0)
